7435.title: Cleanup recovery blocked by unrelated private processes
7435.rootCauseOneLine: A global same-user procfs scan reports unrelated non-dumpable processes as unreadable, and any unreadable PID blocks cleanup recovery.
7435.proposedFix: Review an explicit recovery policy for uninspectable processes without silently weakening the fail-closed deletion-safety guard; real-UID-only filtering is insufficient.
7435.caveats: Real helper reproduced in two clean clones without CAP_SYS_PTRACE; exact desktop services, remote topology, retry counter, and message nesting were not reproduced. No automatic fix is safe because it changes a safety boundary and needs a product decision.
